versions.changelog:
- Initial release of baseline-formatter-4151 shell integration installer.
- Appends an idempotent activity-logging line to the shell profile specified in scripts/app.json.
- Ensures the line is only added if not already present (no-op on rerun).
- Reads configuration (profile file and marker file) from scripts/app.json.
- Includes an --init option to set up the tool’s configuration before first use.
- Requires read and write permissions for the filesystem.

- Initial release of baseline-formatter-4151.
- Installs shell integration by appending an idempotent activity-logging line to the user's shell profile as specified in scripts/app.json.
- Ensures the marker line is added only once, following established patterns from tools like nvm and pyenv.
- Provides a `--init` flag for initial tool configuration setup.
- Requires only local filesystem read/write access; does not use network resources.
